dataset.label: MEPS HC-256: 2024 Full Year Consolidated Data File

cohort.label: Operational current Long COVID at the Round 3/1 2024 interview, adults 18-64
cohort.temporal_estimand: Common Round 3/1 point-in-time status at a 2024 interview for both panels
rule: Primary temporal anchor is suffix 31 for both panels: Panel 28 Round 3 and Panel 29 Round 1, both interviewed in 2024.
AGE31X 18-64 defines age eligibility at the same Round 3/1 interview; AGE24X is diagnostic only.
Interpret COVIDEVER31, LCEVER31, and COVSYMNOW31 using the 2024 PE questionnaire routing rather than treating every -1 as generic missingness.
COVIDEVER31=No followed by structurally inapplicable downstream Long-COVID items is a known operational noncase.
COVIDEVER31=Refused/Don't Know with no downstream resolution is unresolved.
LCEVER31=No is a known Long-COVID-history noncase; LCEVER31=Refused/Don't Know is unresolved.

A substantive or RF/DK COVSYMNOW31 response implies the current-status question was reached after Long-COVID history was established, unless contradictory upstream responses create a routing conflict.
Established Long-COVID history + COVSYMNOW31=Yes is an operational current case; COVSYMNOW31=No is known non-current.
Established Long-COVID history + COVSYMNOW31 RF/DK or unexpected -1 is unresolved current status.
COVSYMNOW31=-1 among people with known no Long-COVID history is an expected structural skip, not current-status nonresponse.
Round-53 variables are diagnostic only and never overwrite the primary Round-31 classification.
Routing contradictions are flagged and left unresolved rather than silently coerced.
cohort.wording_caveat: COVSYMNOW31 asks whether the person has COVID-19 or Long COVID-19 symptoms now. 'Current Long COVID' is an operational label conditional on established Long-COVID history at the common Round 3/1 2024 interview.

design.method: Taylor series linearization, with-replacement MEPS design
design.joint_weight_use: Not used in current pipeline; only for future analyses that jointly use PSAQ and ESAQ variables.
design.subpopulation_method: Create the full weight-specific survey design first, then use survey-domain/subpopulation estimation; do not pre-filter the raw file to the Long COVID cohort.
design.lonely_psu_policy: R survey options survey.lonely.psu='adjust' and survey.adjust.domain.lonely=TRUE; record this software policy in artifact provenance.
design.ci_method: 95% t-based confidence interval using survey design degrees of freedom for totals/means/proportions.
design.missingness: MEPS negative reserved codes are NA for analytical outcomes unless a code is a substantive category explicitly retained. Missing outcome responses are not coerced to zero.

measures.analytical_transformation: Use for temporal diagnostics and panel-specific cohort composition
measures.interpretation: Distinguishes Panel 28 from Panel 29; primary cohort still uses common suffix 31.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Do not use Panel 29 suffix 53 as a 2024 current-status measurement.

measures.universe: HC-256 persons with Round 3/1 age information
measures.analytical_transformation: Primary age filter: 18 <= AGE31X <= 64
measures.interpretation: Defines age eligibility at the same 2024 interview as COVSYMNOW31.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Do not substitute AGE24X when describing age at the Round 3/1 status assessment.

measures.analytical_transformation: Do not use for primary cohort; compare with AGE31X to quantify age-boundary differences
measures.interpretation: Calendar-year-end age diagnostic.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Not the primary age-at-assessment anchor.

measures.universe: Persons routed to PE350 or carrying preserved prior Yes status
measures.analytical_transformation: Interpret with LCEVER31/COVSYMNOW31 routing; No + downstream structural skip is known noncase; RF/DK unresolved
measures.interpretation: Antecedent COVID-history/routing field for primary cohort.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Do not treat every -1 as No or every -1 as generic nonresponse.

measures.universe: Persons routed to PE350 or carrying preserved prior Yes status
measures.analytical_transformation: Retain for diagnostics only; never determines primary Round-31 cohort membership
measures.interpretation: Secondary routing diagnostic.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: For Panel 29, suffix 53 is Round 3 with interview in 2025 and is not a 2024 current-status anchor.

measures.conceptual_measure: Ever had COVID-19 symptoms lasting >=3 months, Round 3/1
measures.universe: Adults for whom Long COVID item is applicable
measures.missing_reserved_values: negative reserved codes including -8 Don't Know, -7 Refused, -1 Inapplicable
measures.denominator: Adults 18-64 at AGE31X with route-aware Long-COVID-history classification
measures.analytical_transformation: Primary route-aware history field at Round 3/1; interpret with COVIDEVER31 and COVSYMNOW31
measures.interpretation: Primary Long-COVID-history routing field.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Do not combine with LCEVER53 to create a generic latest-ever primary cohort.

measures.conceptual_measure: Ever had COVID-19 symptoms lasting >=3 months, Round 5/3
measures.universe: Adults for whom Long COVID item is applicable
measures.missing_reserved_values: negative reserved codes including -8 Don't Know, -7 Refused, -1 Inapplicable
measures.analytical_transformation: Diagnostic only; never determines primary Round-31 cohort membership
measures.interpretation: Secondary Long-COVID-history diagnostic.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Do not use Panel 29 Round-3/2025 information to redefine the 2024 primary cohort.

measures.conceptual_measure: Has COVID-19 or Long COVID-19 symptoms now, Round 3/1
measures.universe: Persons reporting Long COVID in current or prior round
measures.missing_reserved_values: negative reserved codes including -8 Don't Know, -7 Refused if present, -1 Inapplicable

measures.conceptual_measure: Has COVID-19 or Long COVID-19 symptoms now, Round 5/3
measures.universe: Persons reporting Long COVID in current or prior round
measures.missing_reserved_values: negative reserved codes including -8 Don't Know, -7 Refused, -1 Inapplicable

measures.interpretation: Secondary temporal diagnostic.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Panel 29 COVSYMNOW53 is a Round-3 interview occurring in 2025 and must not be labeled 2024 current status.

measures.interpretation: Potential future severity/context measure.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Do not use as a proxy for current Long COVID if history/current-symptom classification is unavailable.

measures.interpretation: Potential future severity/context measure.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Not a standalone Long COVID case definition.

measures.conceptual_measure: Annualized hours on own medical visits / filling prescriptions

measures.interpretation: Annualized time spent on own medical visits/filling prescriptions among valid ESAQ respondents.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Not diagnostic-delay time; do not sum with other ESAQ time domains.

measures.conceptual_measure: Annualized hours paying/managing medical bills or insurance

measures.interpretation: Annualized bills/insurance-management time among valid ESAQ respondents.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Do not sum into a diagnostic-burden score.

measures.conceptual_measure: Annualized hours on health care paperwork / finding doctors / plan information / approvals

measures.conceptual_measure: Health insurance denied/delayed prior approval before service/treatment/visit/drug
measures.valid_values: 1 Yes; 2 No; 3 never insured in past year; 4 not applicable/have not used services

measures.interpretation: Share of the exact yes/no-response universe reporting denial/delay.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Do not label as percent of all Long COVID patients or as diagnosis-related prior authorization.

measures.interpretation: Nonspecific psychological distress score distribution in cohort.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Not psychiatric diagnosis; do not monetize or claim Long COVID/diagnostic delay caused distress.
